app_fee.value: A complete degree application includes a $70 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Applicants applying to any OHSU School of Medicine graduate program who are economically disadvantaged, have extenuating circumstances and/or participated in a qualifying program are eligible to request an application fee waiver based on funding availability.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants applying to any OHSU School of Medicine graduate program who are economically disadvantaged, have extenuating circumstances and/or participated in a qualifying program are eligible to request an application fee waiver. Graduate Studies provides a limited number of application fee waivers each academic year and these waivers are granted based on funding availability and are not guaranteed.

gre_general.value: Standardized tests are not a requirement for admission to the School of Medicine. However, individual graduate programs may choose to require the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) during admissions.
gre_general.quote: Standardized tests are not a requirement for admission to the School of Medicine. However, individual graduate programs may choose to require the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) during admissions.

toefl_min.value: There is no central Graduate Studies minimum TOEFL score requirement; minimums are determined by individual degree programs.
toefl_min.quote:
What minimum TOEFL score is required?
Please check directly with the program(s) in which you are applying.

ielts_min.value: There is no central Graduate Studies minimum IELTS score requirement; minimums are determined by individual degree programs.
ielts_min.quote:
What minimum TOEFL score is required?
Please check directly with the program(s) in which you are applying.

english_waiver.value: These will only be waived if the applicant has obtained an undergraduate or graduate degree at an accredited college or university in the United States or other native English-speaking country.
english_waiver.quote: These will only be waived if the applicant has obtained an undergraduate or graduate degree at an accredited college or university in the United States or other native English-speaking country.
